name: Lying Quad Stretch
steps: Lie on one side on the floor with your bottom arm supporting your head and your bottom leg bent slightly forward for stability.
Bend the top knee and grasp your ankle with your top hand.
Keep your thighs aligned and draw the heel gently toward your buttock until you feel a stretch across the front of the thigh.
Hold the stretch steadily while breathing smoothly on one side, then release gently and switch sides.
tips: Avoid overarching your lower back by keeping your abs lightly engaged and tailbone tucked.
Keep your top thigh parallel to the floor rather than letting your knee lift high toward the ceiling.
